shared_elements: low-relief carving on a flat upright slab
animals/creatures rendered in profile with prominent eyes and snouts
a row of repeated similar heads along the top
justification: Both are low-relief upright slabs bearing profile animal heads with large round eyes, and both organise imagery into horizontal registers, most notably a row of similar heads across the top. But A depicts a sparse figural scene (a large quadruped/reptile, birds, a fox-like creature, a human-like figure and a band of net pattern) with much blank ground, whereas B is a densely packed grid of dozens of repeated square sign-blocks filling the whole surface — an entirely different organising logic and repertoire.
